historical_disposition_readback.method: Read actual content of B01 historical review and every 147 B02–B08 partition from pinned algorithm. For each exact rebaseline row join by category and original node/filter identity, exact source span, disposition, module/blob and part; compare file blob, PASS and counts, duplicate checks within parts. Existing previous CP321 supplement supplies complete canonical row identity and cross-part uniqueness. Inspect interpretation, source anchor, verification, relevance reason, contract reference presence for B02–B08; null contract_ref occurs only on justified NOT_APPLICABLE rows. B01 all 74 interpretations read directly against five source modules. Inherited historical dispositions remain source-first prior W1 evidence on unchanged source, not a newly independent semantic interpretation of every row.
historical_disposition_readback.qualification: Findings counted as recorded historical resolutions; not independent re-resolution of 325 findings. Supplemental items counted as existing evidence, not new independent W3 review.
